input_message.subject_or_title: Urgent Notice: Annual Mandatory Password Rotation Policy
input_message.body_text: Attention staff: In compliance with ISO 27001 security standards, your corporate Active Directory password will expire in 7 days. Please change your password directly from your Windows Ctrl+Alt+Del menu or visit our verified single sign-on portal at hxxps[:]//sso[.]company[.]com/idp/profile. IT Security Team.

AT-01.triage_narrative: Classified as legitimate business message (P=5.5%). Although sensitive topics ('password'/'payroll') or urgency terms appear, the sender domain is verified ('internal_trusted') and destination links are legitimate corporate assets.

false_positive_impact_analysis.conclusion: TF-IDF exhibits false-positive inflation on legitimate password notices due to keyword overlap ('password', 'urgent', 'expire'). Advanced Hybrid uses verified sender domain and legitimate portal link to suppress the false positive, safely categorizing it as Benign.

AT-02.condition: Phishing uses unfamiliar phrasing (Novel Campaign Excluded from Training)

input_message.body_text: A collaborating research partner has shared a synchronized encrypted workspace folder with your enterprise identity. To synchronize local metadata and review project documentation, validate your domain authorization token at hxxps[:]//docs-sync-federation[.]live/workspace/share-99.

AT-02.triage_narrative: Elevated risk detected (P=85.2%). Primary risk drivers: structural anomalies. The message exhibits characteristic social-engineering coercion and unverified destination links.
AT-02.conclusion: Despite unfamiliar vocabulary ('synchronized encrypted workspace folder', 'telemetry validation'), the system detects structural risk cues (unverified domain, abnormal tokenization) and routes uncertain samples to manual triage (Abstain) rather than letting attacks slip through as safe.

AT-03.original_text: Action Required: Microsoft 365 Account Deactivation Warning. Verify your password at hxxps[:]//login-micros0ft-support[.]xyz/auth
AT-03.perturbed_text: Acti0n Requ1red::: M1cr0s0ft 365 Acc0unt Deactivati0n Warn1ng*** Verify at h-x-x-p-s [ : ] // login - micros0ft - support [ . ] xyz / auth
AT-03.model_limitation_disclosure: Model Limitation Revealed: Punctuation splitting ('h-x-x-p-s') and leetspeak alter character n-gram tokens. Pure TF-IDF suffers probability drop when regex fails to isolate the URL token. Advanced Hybrid mitigates this by utilizing sender domain classification and caps/syntax density features.
